title: Amazon Reportedly Targeting Up To $42 Billion In Bond Sale
key_facts: IBD says Amazon filed for a corporate bond sale on a Tuesday, seeking roughly $37 billion to $42 billion in dollars and euros, citing a report
The money is to help fund its AI spending
The page metadata shows the article was published 10 Mar 2026; Google News re-dated it to 3 Oct 2026
Only the first paragraph is readable; the rest is behind the IBD paywall
Separately, Morgan Stanley data relayed by BigGo Finance (C07-12) says Amazon issued a 4.25 billion pound bond in September 2026
quote_evidence: Amazon (AMZN) filed for a corporate bond sale Tuesday, with the tech giant looking to raise up to $42 billion to help power it AI ambitions.
The e-commerce and cloud-computing leader is looking to raise roughly $37 billion to $42 billion in an offering in dollars and euros, according to a report
why_it_matters_hint: Shows how heavily the largest cloud companies borrow for AI, but the filing dates from March 2026, not this week
notes: Older news re-dated: IBD metadata datePublished 2026-03-10; Google News lists it as 3 Oct 2026. Paywalled after first paragraph; the underlying report IBD cites is not named in the visible text. No other outlet in the 3-day window carries a new Amazon $42bn bond sale.
